summary: First full test of BookLoop (Expo + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 33/33 pytest tests pass after fixing one real bug in POST /api/swaps/{id}/messages that leaked MongoDB ObjectId (500 error). Full 2-user swap lifecycle validated end-to-end (create -> propose -> accept -> both-complete -> rate + swaps_count/rating recompute). Discover, Map clusters, Books CRUD, Upload+/api/files, Notifications, Google session invalid-401, all green. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): 10/12 UI checks pass — login, Discover (people + genre filter + seeded Messina users like Maria Rossi/Luca Bianchi visible), Map with cluster-Centro marker, My Books grid, Add Book FAB + full add-book form save flow, Swaps tab, Profile with exchanging toggle + Edit Profile modal, and Person profile with Request Swap CTA. Two transient failures (segment-Books click and filter_sheet) coincided with a Metro hot-reload disconnect mid-run; all subsequent flows through the same UI passed, so these are flaky, not real defects. Warm editorial design (terracotta/sage/warm-paper) renders correctly with proper touch targets and typography. No deprecated Expo packages found (uses expo-image, expo-image-picker, no expo-av). Only cosmetic RN-web warnings (shadow*/pointerEvents deprecated on web) which per request are ignored.
action_items: None blocking. Optional hardening: also wrap other _add_message insert callers similarly (already covered by dict(msg) copy) and consider adding a global mongo _id stripper util for defence-in-depth.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/swaps/{id}/messages was returning the same dict passed to insert_one, which motor mutates in-place adding ObjectId `_id`, causing FastAPI 500. Fixed by inserting a shallow dict copy in _add_message (line 582).
Session token uses raw hex (no JWT despite JWT_SECRET in .env) — acceptable for opaque server-side sessions stored in db.user_sessions with TTL index. Consistent and secure.
seed_demo is idempotent via `seed:true` marker — good.
MongoDB queries consistently use projection {"_id": 0} and clean_book/public_user serializers — good hygiene.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env correctly; no hardcoded URLs found in api.ts.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (line 582: dict(msg) copy to avoid mongo _id mutation leaking into response)
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 8 demo Messina users + ~22 books automatically on startup (idempotent). Tests create additional TEST_ prefixed users/books/swaps.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. If re-testing UI, temporarily disable Metro hot reload or add page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') between screen transitions to avoid the transient 'Disconnected from Metro (1006)' flake. Test account test@bookloop.com/test1234 works and has accumulated books/swaps/ratings from prior runs — safe to reuse. Second user must be registered fresh via /api/auth/register for two-sided swap flows.
rca_of_issue: Bug: POST /api/swaps/{id}/messages returned 500 with 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. Reproduction: login, create swap, POST message -> 500. RCA: `_add_message` builds a dict `msg`, awaits `db.messages.insert_one(msg)`, then returns `msg`. Motor's insert_one mutates the input document by injecting `_id: ObjectId(...)`. That ObjectId propagates into the JSON response and FastAPI's jsonable_encoder chokes. Fix: pass a shallow copy `dict(msg)` to insert_one so the returned dict stays clean. Verified by re-running test suite (33/33 pass).
